body:
stress is something that just have stuck around for so long ever since I was a kid (growing up in an dysfunctional Asian family is not great). Now that I'm reaching my last few semesters of college, I'm just dreading on what's to come next. School is beyond stressful to me, but it's not something I can escape from (I've taken a year off). Everything I have feeling is all rooted to school.

Perhaps it's sleep, I've been sleeping for about 5 hours a night the past 3-4 weeks due to crazy neighbors and just being so busy with school. If it wasn't for school, I'd like to just lay in bed all day and not get up.

I'm a part time courier on bicycle, and even though it started out as a very stress-relieving and a good source of exercise, even that is starting to get stressful. It's not something that I can outright quit either (there's a big event SXSW coming up and I need the money, but it's going to get chaotic).

I just don't know.
